exposure: Educational level (None/Primary school, Secondary school, High school, University degree or higher)
outcome: Proportion of STEMI patients treated with percutaneous coronary intervention within 90 minutes (primary PCI)
Proportion of HF patients who underwent surgery within 2 days
Proportion of women with primary C-section
cohort: Patients discharged from public and private hospitals in the Lazio region between 2012 and 2015, living in the Lazio region
finding: The study found a reduction in the differential access to effective healthcare services, as measured by primary PCI for STEMI, surgery within 2 days for hip fracture, and primary C-section rates, among individuals with different educational levels in the Lazio region between 2012 and 2015.
mod_finding: The proportion of women with primary C-section decreased from 31.5% in 2012 to 27.7% in 2015, with the improvement in outcomes involving both the least and most educated patients.
